note: Cargo terminal places, model-local metres (Art/CargoTerminal: x along the building from its west end, y from the airside face (0) to the landside face (70), z up from the hall floor). In the game: Airfield.cpp spawns the model at plan (cargoBuilding x0, y0) with yaw 180 and ABabylonModel::Place adds its own half turn, so the two cancel: plan x = x0 + x, plan y = y0 + y; Unreal world cm = model root location + (x, -y, z) * 100. ETV lanes: depth 1 is the deepest (against the back), depth 2 next to the ETV aisle. staticULD: a fixed ULD is modelled there (the cargo system must treat it as taken). Data only - written by Art/CargoTerminal/cargo_doors.py.
